sources.title: OLMo from Ai2
sources.snippet: OLMo 2 1B is the smallest member of the OLMo model family, surpassing peer models like Gemma 3 1B or Llama 3.2 1B. The 1B model size enables rapid iteration for researchers, more local development, and a more complete picture of how our recipe scales.
